after.tests/test_notices.py:
# owner: platform
import unittest
from datetime import date

from rosterkit.errors import ProjectError
from rosterkit.models import Mark, Student
from rosterkit.notices import absence_notice

PUPIL = Student("s1", "Lee", "Ana", "A")

def _mark(day, status, who="s1"):
    return Mark(who, date(2026, 9, day), status)

class NoticeTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_lists_absent_days_in_order(self):
        marks = [_mark(9, "absent"), _mark(8, "late")]
        marks.append(_mark(3, "absent"))
        text = absence_notice(PUPIL, marks)
        want = "Ana Lee missed 2 day(s): "
        want += "2026-09-03, 2026-09-09."
        self.assertEqual(text, want)

    def test_other_student_raises(self):
        marks = [_mark(3, "absent")]
        marks.append(_mark(4, "absent", "s2"))
        with self.assertRaises(ProjectError):
            absence_notice(PUPIL, marks)

    def test_no_absences_raises(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ProjectError):
            absence_notice(PUPIL, [_mark(3, "late")])
